div.div:
Notes
*1 Principle: write local, place cross-cloud dependency on the read side
A write path that crosses clouds couples ingest to the remote API. The read side is cacheable and retriable.
*2 Network reachability and ONTAP mobility are different questions
FlexCache with a non-AWS ONTAP service as Origin is unverified in this repository.
